title: IngestBatchResponse
description: Response body for POST /v1/ingest/batches, per architecture.md §2. Per-entity accept/reject, not just a batch-level status code.

replayed.description: True when this batch_id was already processed and the cached response is being returned (idempotent replay, no re-processing).

accepted.description: URNs of entities that passed validation and were enqueued to the fan-out worker.
